title: Todd Monken: I wouldn't say Deshaun Watson is playing to earn start in Week 3

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken: I wouldn't say Deshaun Watson is playing to earn start in Week 3
sources.description: Browns head coach Todd Monken stuck with Deshaun Watson as the team's starting quarterback for this week's game against the Buccaneers, but some are already looking ahead to what he'll do in Week 3.
